title: Two tabs on one document share one local-copy key: a save or «تجاهل» in one tab deletes the other tab's unsaved copy, and the conflict message then tells Anas to reload, which loses his text
evidence: draftKey is `anasaq:draft:${collection}:${docId}` (CollectionForm.tsx:53-55), one key per document for every tab of the browser. The autosave effect (205-218) writes the form there on every change and removes the key once the form equals its saved version (draftStorageAction, fields.ts:234-236); discardLocalOffer calls clearStoredDraft (244-248). Nothing listens to the `storage` event and nothing guards beforeunload (grep of src/: no beforeunload, the only 'storage' listeners are in the cart). On a 23505 the failed save writes nothing and changes no effect dependency, yet the message says `CONFLICT_MESSAGE = 'تغيّر هذا المستند منذ فتحته. نصّك محفوظ هنا؛ حمّل آخر نسخة ثم أعد التعديل.'` (line 35, shown at 263). The e2e that claims the stale save 'keeps the typed text' (tests/e2e/cms.spec.ts:659-693) opens the two pages in two separate browser contexts, so they never share localStorage, and it never reloads.
impact: Anas opens the same post or room in two tabs of one browser (a duplicated or restored tab, or a link opened twice). Tab B holds unsaved text; tab A types (overwriting B's copy) and saves (removing the key). Tab B's save is refused with «… نصّك محفوظ هنا؛ حمّل آخر نسخة …»; he reloads as told and no copy is offered: tab B's text is gone. The same happens if tab B is simply closed after tab A saved or answered «تجاهل» on B's copy (no leave warning exists). Only one tab's work ever survives in storage.
proposed_fix: In save()'s error branch, write this tab's own copy before showing the conflict message (`localStorage.setItem(draftKey(...), JSON.stringify({ baseSeq, data, savedAt: Date.now(), userId: userIdRef.current }))`), so the reload the message asks for offers it with the stale-base warning; and add a `beforeunload` listener while `!equalData(data, initialData)` so a tab whose stored copy another tab removed cannot be closed silently. Extend the conflict e2e to one context with two pages and a reload.
proof_recipe: Playwright, ONE browser context, two pages signed in as the same owner, a saved post open in both (/admin/content/posts/edit?id=<id>). page2: fill «العنوان» with 'stale-B'. page1: fill «العنوان» with 'fresh-A', click «حفظ», wait for «تم الحفظ.». page2: click «حفظ» -> CONFLICT_MESSAGE shows. page2.reload(). Expected by the message: the banner «يوجد تعديل غير محفوظ محليًا لهذا المستند.» offering 'stale-B'. Wrong result to expect: no banner, «العنوان» shows 'fresh-A', and localStorage.getItem('anasaq:draft:posts:<id>') is null.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 S08.2/S08.3/S08.5 and AUDIT-2 ADMIN-editor-2/FIX-admin-1 fixed the single-tab paths; the shared key across tabs was never covered (the conflict e2e uses two contexts).

title: The email problems table shows P08's six new mail kinds as raw English codes (order_link, owner_alert, notify_confirm …)
evidence: `const KIND_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { receipt: 'إيصال', contact_notice: 'إشعار رسالة', availability: 'إشعار توفر' }` and the cell renders `{KIND_LABEL[row.kind] ?? row.kind}` (line 215). P08 widened the outbox to `'receipt', 'contact_notice', 'availability', 'order_link', 'order_shipped', 'order_refunded', 'order_ready', 'notify_confirm', 'owner_alert'` (20261002100000_payment_core.sql:48-51), and outbox_attention() returns every kind (20261002120000_order_emails.sql:403-430, no kind filter). EmailView.tsx was last changed in 9bd72b8 (AUDIT-2), before P08.
impact: When a buyer's order link, a shipping or refund notice, or an owner alert is exhausted or bounces, Anas or operations sees «order_link» or «owner_alert» in the «النوع» column and cannot tell which mail failed for a buyer; the same class of defect AUDIT-1 S10.3 fixed for the status column.
proposed_fix: Add the six kinds to KIND_LABEL (for example order_link 'رابط الطلب', order_shipped 'إشعار شحن', order_refunded 'إشعار استرداد', order_ready 'جاهز للاستلام', notify_confirm 'تأكيد التنبيه', owner_alert 'تنبيه للمالك') and a unit test that every kind in the outbox check constraint has a label.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 S10.3 (same table, status column) fixed; this column was not extended when P08 added kinds.

title: After the server refuses a role change (last owner, invalid, network), the team table keeps showing the refused role in that member's row, with «حفظ» still enabled
evidence: The row's select shows `const role = roleEdits[member.user_id] ?? member.role` (line 170). `roleEdits` is written only by the select's onChange (186-188) and never cleared: not after a refused set_role (runAction 93-96 sets actionError and reloads the directory, which refreshes `member.role` but not the edit), not after the step-up retry (99-113). staff-admin refuses demoting the last active owner with `fail(409, 'LAST_OWNER', 'يجب أن يبقى مالك نشط واحد على الأقل.')` (supabase/functions/staff-admin/index.ts:25).
impact: The owner demotes the only owner, or picks a role while the network drops: the error line appears under the invite form at the bottom of the page, while the member's row still reads «محرر» (the refused choice) and offers «حفظ». A screenshot or a later glance at the team table states a role the member does not have; the owner may believe a demotion took effect when it did not (or retry it blindly).
proposed_fix: Drop the member's entry from `roleEdits` whenever an action on that member returns (success or refusal), e.g. `setRoleEdits(({ [userId]: _, ...rest }) => rest)` after runAction/onStepUpVerified for set_role, so the select falls back to `member.role` from the reloaded directory; and show the refusal next to the row it concerns.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 S10.9 (stale «نشط» after BAN_FAILED) fixed the status column; FIX-A1-02 (this run) covers the missing confirm on set_role, not the stale select.

title: A photo added to a room gallery, the book's photos, cover or objects, or the home portrait publishes with an empty alt: the CMS alt starts blank, the publish gate accepts it, and the page ignores the alt the library required at upload
evidence: `galleryPhotoFields = [{ name: 'id', … type: 'image' }, { name: 'alt', label: 'الوصف البديل', type: 'text' }]` (rooms.ts:41-44, reused by the passed gallery, shelf photos and images, the book's cover, standing, spine, bookmark and photos at 258-261 and 240-245); `homeFields` has `{ name: 'portraitAlt', … type: 'text' }` (site-settings.ts:60); none is nonBlank and roomPublishSchemas (321-346) and siteSettingsSchema add no alt rule. «أضف عنصرًا» creates the item from `defaultsForFields` (FieldInput.tsx:747-751), so `alt: ''`, and choosing a library image only sets the id (FieldInput.tsx:224-227). The views pass the CMS value straight through: `
impact: Every new product or book photo Anas adds is published as alt="" (decorative) unless he notices the empty «الوصف البديل» box: screen-reader users get nothing for meaningful photos on /passed, /shelf, /book and the home portrait, although the library made him write an alt for the same image. A WCAG 1.1.1 failure introduced by normal editing.
proposed_fix: Add a publish-only rule (in roomPublishSchemas' superRefine and siteSettingsSchema, not the lenient loader schemas) that refuses a blank `alt` where an image id is set, with an Arabic message; and, when the picker hands back a library image, prefill the sibling `alt` from the row's alt_ar if it is empty.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-2 4.8 (PUBLIC-data-3, X-A11Y-RTL-3) fixed the library alt for vignettes and story figures only (alt_ar granted to anon, StoryFigure fallback); the CMS-alt lists were left as they are.

title: The email problems screen silently shows only the newest 200 problem rows; bounced rows never leave that list, so once 200 accumulate an older exhausted mail vanishes and «تحتاج تدخل» says «لا توجد مشكلات من هذا النوع.»
evidence: outbox_attention() returns rows whose `status in ('exhausted','uncertain','suppressed') or delivery in ('bounced','complained','failed')` `order by o.created_at desc limit 200` (20261002120000_order_emails.sql:421-425): the non-actionable sent-and-bounced rows compete with the actionable ones for the 200 places. Sent rows are never purged (every `delete from finance.email_outbox` excludes 'sent': notifications.sql:314-317, 426-429; privacy_requests.sql:129-131), so bounces and complaints (notify_confirm goes to visitor-typed addresses) pile up for ever. EmailView loads that list once (75-84), filters it locally (132-139, its own comment at 50 says 'capped at 200 rows, so it is filtered locally') and renders `{rows?.length ? 'لا توجد مشكلات من هذا النوع.' : 'لا توجد مشكلات في البريد.'}` (188) with no note that the list is cut; AdminHome at least prints «N+» (AdminHome.tsx:66, 187, 312-313).
impact: After 200 bounces or complaints have accumulated, an exhausted order link or receipt that is older than the newest 200 problem rows is not listed anywhere: the «تحتاج تدخل» filter tells the owner or operations there is nothing to do, and the home counts «0+». A buyer's undelivered order mail is never replayed.
proposed_fix: Order actionable rows first in outbox_attention (`order by (o.status in ('exhausted','uncertain')) desc, o.created_at desc`), and show «تُعرض أحدث 200 مشكلة فقط.» on the email screen when 200 rows come back.
proof_recipe: SQL as postgres: insert 200 finance.email_outbox rows kind 'notify_confirm', status 'sent', delivery 'bounced', created_at now(); then one row kind 'order_link', status 'exhausted', created_at now() - interval '1 day'. Sign in as owner, open /admin/email, press «تحتاج تدخل». Wrong result: «لا توجد مشكلات من هذا النوع.» and the owner home shows «مشكلات تحتاج انتباهًا: 0+», while the exhausted row exists.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 L6 / R3 added the cap and the «+» on the home only; OPS-PRIVACY-07 (this run) records that sent rows are never purged, for privacy, not for this list.

title: The owner home names a failed scheduled publish by its raw id: a post appears as a 36-character UUID and a room as «started», and the line stays for 7 days after it is fixed
evidence: Each failure renders `{COLLECTION_LABELS[failure.collection] ?? failure.collection}: <bdi>{failure.docId}</bdi>` (409-410), where docId is the audit row's entity_id: a random UUID for posts (CollectionList.tsx:95) and the English slug for rooms. The list is every `content.publish_due_failed` audit row of the last 7 days (227-241, PUBLISH_FAILED_WINDOW_MS at 63), with no check that the document has since been published or rescheduled. The media library already maps the same ids to names (`whereUsedLabel`, MediaLibrary.tsx:97-109, AUDIT-1 S09.10).
impact: Anas reads «تعذّر نشر 1 من المحتوى المجدول في آخر 7 أيام: المقالات: 3f2a9c1e-…» and cannot tell which article missed its date without opening it; after he fixes and republishes it the red line keeps saying it failed for the rest of the week, which trains him to ignore the section.
proposed_fix: Reuse the media library's label rule (room and policy names, «المقالات · <first 8>», or better the post title from content_documents.latest_data), and drop failures whose document is live at a seq ≥ the failed seq or has a newer pending schedule.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-2 4.3 added this list; AUDIT-1 S09.10 fixed the same raw-UUID display in the media library.

title: A long article that passes a rich-text size limit cannot be published, and the form explains it in English with a raw schema path («النص › root › children › 1 › children › 1 › text: Too big: …»)
evidence: richtext.ts sets limits without messages: `text: z.string().max(20000)` (19), `z.array(inlineOrBlock).max(2000)` (15), root `.max(1000)` (53), list `.max(500)` (38), `httpsUrl = z.url({ protocol: /^https$/ }).max(2000)` (25). No zod locale is configured (grep for z.config/locales: none; zod 4.6.5). Reproduced with the repo's zod (SCRATCH/ADMIN-CMS/rt-check.cjs): a paragraph holding one 20,001-character text node gives `{"path":["root","children",0,"children",0,"text"],"message":"Too big: expected string to have <=20000 characters"}`, 1,001 blocks give `Too big: expected array to have <=1000 items`. CollectionForm prints `{where}: {issue.message}` (340-346) and fieldPathLabel stops resolving at a richtext field (fields.ts:251-253: scope becomes [] and each later segment is printed as is).
impact: Anas pastes a long text (a chapter without paragraph breaks, or a long essay pasted as plain text, which Lexical turns into one paragraph per line, blank lines included, so 500 paragraphs reach the 1,000-block cap): Save works, Publish and Schedule stay disabled, and the only explanation is an English sentence after a path of English words. He cannot tell what to shorten.
proposed_fix: Give each limit an Arabic message (for example 'الفقرة أطول من 20000 حرف؛ قسّمها.' and 'النص أطول من 1000 فقرة؛ قسّمه أو احذف الأسطر الفارغة.'), and make fieldPathLabel stop at a richtext field (print its label only).
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 X3.21 and AUDIT-2 FIX-admin-3 translated field paths for groups and lists; AUDIT-2 4.5 gave the union an Arabic message. The size limits and the paths inside a richtext value were left in English.

title: «حذف» on a list item or paragraph removes it at once with no confirm or undo, and the autosave writes the deletion into the local copy, so the unsaved text in that item cannot be brought back
evidence: List items: `onClick={() => onChange(items.filter((_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index))}` (737), paragraphs the same (663); the button sits in one row with «أعلى» and «أسفل» (712-741, 638-667). CollectionForm's autosave then writes the form, deletion included, to localStorage on that same change (CollectionForm.tsx:205-218), so a reload offers the copy WITH the item gone; «تجاهل» returns the last saved version and drops every other unsaved edit. A deleted item has no textarea left for the browser's own undo. AUDIT-2 ADMIN-editor-11 named exactly this ('delete has no undo') and suggested a confirm or one-step undo; the fix in R03 added only the aria-labels (643-663, 717-737).
impact: On a phone, Anas mis-taps «حذف» beside «أسفل» on a book excerpt, a stage of «بدأتُ من هنا» with several new paragraphs, or a scene caption he just wrote: the item and its unsaved text are gone with no way back except discarding all his other unsaved edits too (or retyping).
proposed_fix: Keep the last removed item and offer «تراجع» in the list's status line for one step (`setUndo({ index, item })`, restore with `onChange([...items.slice(0, index), item, ...items.slice(index)])`), or ask `window.confirm('حذف هذا العنصر؟')` when the item holds non-empty text.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-2 ADMIN-editor-11: the naming half was fixed, the undo/confirm half was not.

title: Text typed while the editor reloads after «نشر», «جدولة», «إلغاء الجدولة», «أرشفة» or «استعادة» is silently replaced: the form stays editable, autosave is off for the reload and the loaded data overwrites the keystrokes
evidence: PublishBar calls onChanged → `void load()` after every successful action (CollectionForm.tsx:373, PublishBar.tsx:62-64), and VersionHistory calls onRestored → load() (392). A reload after the first keeps the form mounted and editable (`if (!loadedOnceRef.current) setLoading(true)`, 143) but sets `hydratedRef.current = false` (138), which makes the autosave effect skip every change (206). After two awaited reads (146-151, 158) it runs `setInitialData(loadedData); setData(loadedData)` (172-173) and bumps loadGeneration, which remounts the fields (323) and the rich-text editor. Nothing compares the form with what it held when the reload started; the e2e suite works around the window ('interacting mid-load races the CollectionForm remount and the loaded values', tests/e2e/media.spec.ts:376-377).
impact: Anas presses «نشر» (or «جدولة» and keeps writing) and goes on typing a correction in the body or a title while the publish and the reload run, which on a phone connection is one to several seconds: everything typed in that window disappears when the reload lands, no local copy holds it, and the editor loses the caret. Bounded to that window, but silent.
proposed_fix: Keep a ref to the latest `data` and, in load(), when the ref differs from the initialData the reload started from, write it as the local copy before replacing the form (so the offer brings it back), or disable the fields (fieldset disabled) while a reload is in flight.
proof_recipe: Playwright on a saved, valid post: route('**/rest/v1/content_documents**') to delay responses by 3 s; click «نشر», wait for «نشر: تم بنجاح.», then immediately fill «مقتطف» with 'typed-during-reload'; let the delayed request finish. Wrong result: «مقتطف» shows the saved excerpt, no offer banner appears after a page reload, and localStorage has no 'anasaq:draft:posts:<id>' entry containing 'typed-during-reload'.
prior_overlap: FOUNDATION-1 fixed overlapping loads (ticket) but not edits made during a reload.

title: A new article that was never saved cannot be found again: its local copy sits under a random id that no screen lists, so closing the tab or leaving through the menu (to upload its cover in «المكتبة») loses the way back to it
evidence: «جديد» opens `documentHref('posts', crypto.randomUUID().toLowerCase())` (CollectionList.tsx:94-96). Autosave writes the typing to `anasaq:draft:posts:<that uuid>` (CollectionForm.tsx:53-55, 205-218), but the posts list is built only from saved rows: `docIds = … rows ? Array.from(rows.keys()) : []` (81-92, rows from content_documents, 64-74), and no other screen reads draft keys (AdminShell only counts and clears them, AdminShell.tsx:38-58). The image picker in the form only browses the library (MediaPicker.tsx:41); uploading a new cover means leaving for /admin/media. The editor's own header comment promises 'a conflict or a closed tab never loses text' (CollectionForm.tsx:7-8).
impact: Anas starts a new article, writes it, and before saving goes to «المكتبة» to upload its cover, or closes the tab: back in «المحتوى › المقالات» the article is not listed, «جديد» makes another id, and his text stays invisible in localStorage until a sign-out deletes it. Only the browser's Back button or history can reach it, which a non-developer will not think of.
proposed_fix: In CollectionList for posts, also list local draft keys `anasaq:draft:posts:*` that have no saved row (own userId only), as «مسودة محلية غير محفوظة» linking to their editor; or save the first version automatically on the first edit of a new document.
proof_recipe: Playwright as owner: /admin/content/posts → «جديد» → fill «العنوان» 'unsaved-new-post' (do not save) → click the nav link «المكتبة» → click «المحتوى» → «المقالات». Wrong result: no row 'unsaved-new-post' in the table, while localStorage holds a key 'anasaq:draft:posts:<uuid>' whose data.title is 'unsaved-new-post'.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 S08.3 made autosave synchronous; nothing made an unsaved new document reachable.

title: On a slow uplink a large photo can never be uploaded: every part must arrive within the ticket's 5 minutes, the completion is then refused as «انتهت صلاحية التذكرة…», and «إعادة المحاولة» repeats the same race
evidence: runUpload asks for one ticket (252), then uploads the original (up to 15 MiB, MAX_ORIGINAL_BYTES at 26) and up to four derivatives (up to 4 MiB each, 28) one after another (262-268), then calls media-complete (269). The ticket row has `expires_at … default now() + interval '5 minutes'` (20260926090000_media_library.sql:107) and media_claim refuses `t.expires_at <= now()` with 55000 (253-255), which the function maps to `410 GONE 'انتهت صلاحية التذكرة أو استُخدمت من قبل.'` (supabase/functions/_shared/media.ts:125-126). The signed upload URLs themselves 'are valid for 2 hours' (Supabase createSignedUploadUrl docs), so only the ticket's clock is this short. The retry (427-429) starts a new 5-minute ticket for the same bytes. The busy line only says «جارٍ رفع 1 من N» (263), with no byte progress.
impact: Anas uploads a 12-15 MB phone photo over weak mobile data (below roughly 0.8 Mbit/s upstream the original plus derivatives take more than five minutes): after minutes of «جارٍ رفع 1 من 5» he gets a message about an expired 'ticket' he knows nothing about, and every retry ends the same way. Parts of each failed attempt sit in quarantine until the daily sweep.
proposed_fix: Give the ticket a window that fits the declared bytes (for example `now() + interval '5 minutes' + declared_total_bytes / 50 kB/s`, capped below the 2-hour URL life) or let each uploaded part extend it; and map a GONE completion to «انقطع الرفع أو طال أكثر من المسموح؛ جرّب اتصالًا أسرع أو صورة أصغر.».
proof_recipe: Playwright as owner with page.route on '**/storage/v1/object/upload/sign/**' delaying each upload by 80 s (CDP network throttling to 300 kbit/s upstream works too); upload a 6 MB JPEG through /admin/media. Wrong result: after about 5 minutes the dialog shows «انتهت صلاحية التذكرة أو استُخدمت من قبل.», and «إعادة المحاولة» fails the same way.
prior_overlap: none (I49 records the upload byte cap and rotation issues, not the ticket window).

title: Changing a published article's «المعرّف» silently moves it to a new address: the next build drops the old /journal/<slug> page and every link already shared turns into a 404, with no warning in the editor
evidence: The post's slug is an ordinary editable field (`{ name: 'slug', label: 'المعرّف', type: 'slug' }`, posts.ts:8) rendered as a plain text input (FieldInput.tsx:367-391); nothing in CollectionForm or PublishBar compares it with the live version's slug. The article pages are generated from the published slugs only (journal.ts:59, getPosts), the export is static (D32) and the repository has no redirect source (public/ holds `_headers` but no `_redirects`; grep of PLANS for a slug redirect finds none). The published_documents_post_slug index only stops two live posts sharing one slug.
impact: Anas tidies the Latin slug of an article he has already shared on X or WhatsApp and republishes: within minutes every shared link answers the site's 404, and search results point to a dead page. Nothing told him the address would change.
proposed_fix: In the editor, when a post has a live version and the slug field differs from the live slug, show «تغيير المعرّف يغيّر رابط المقال المنشور، والروابط القديمة لن تعمل.» beside the field; optionally keep old slugs in the document and emit a `_redirects` line per old slug at build time.
prior_overlap: none

title: A new article starts with «ظاهر» unticked: publishing it reports «يظهر التعديل على الموقع خلال دقائق», the list says «منشور», and the article never appears on the journal
evidence: `{ name: 'visible', label: 'ظاهر', type: 'boolean' }` (posts.ts:16) gets its starting value from defaultForField, `case 'boolean': return false` (fields.ts:168-169), which is what a new post opens with (CollectionForm.tsx:165-167). Nothing at publish looks at it: postSchema accepts false, PublishBar answers `${label}: تم بنجاح. يظهر التعديل على الموقع خلال دقائق.` (PublishBar.tsx:63) and CollectionList's statusFor returns «منشور» from seq numbers alone (CollectionList.tsx:41-52). The public side drops it: anon RLS shows a post only `where data -> 'visible' = 'true'` (20260930120000_audit_fixes.sql:49-51) and getPosts keeps `posts.filter(({ post }) => post.visible)` (src/lib/journal.ts:73); the admin preview draws it anyway (RoomPreview.tsx:77-81). Every e2e that publishes a post ticks the box first (`await page.getByLabel('ظاهر').check()`, tests/e2e/cms.spec.ts:112 and 160), so the default path is never exercised.
impact: Anas writes and publishes his first article without noticing the «ظاهر» checkbox: the bar says it will be on the site in minutes, the list says «منشور», the preview shows it, yet /journal never lists it and its link is a 404. He has no way to learn why from the screen.
proposed_fix: Start new posts visible (a `default: true` on the field, or set `visible: true` in the new-post defaults), and make statusFor and the publish message say «منشور، مخفي عن الموقع» when the live version has visible false.
proof_recipe: Playwright as owner: /admin/content/posts → «جديد» → fill «المعرّف» 'hidden-default', «العنوان», «مقتطف», «الكاتب», one word in the body; do NOT touch «ظاهر»; «حفظ» then «نشر». Expect «نشر: تم بنجاح. يظهر التعديل على الموقع خلال دقائق.» and the posts list row «منشور». Wrong result: anon select from published_documents where collection='posts' and doc_id=<id> returns no row, and /journal (next dev) does not list the title.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 S01.1 made `visible: false` posts private; the default and the admin's status were not revisited.

title: «تسجيل الخروج» ignores a failed sign-out: with an expired token and no network, auth-js keeps the session in localStorage, yet the shell sends the person to the sign-in page as if they had left
evidence: `clearDrafts(); await getSupabaseBrowserClient().auth.signOut(); router.replace('/admin/sign-in')` (AdminShell.tsx:131-133) never reads the result. In the installed @supabase/auth-js 2.117.1, `_signOut` returns early when the session cannot be loaded: `if (sessionError && !isAuthSessionMissingError(sessionError)) { return this._returnResult({ error: sessionError }) }` (GoTrueClient.js:3434-3436), before `_removeSession()`; and `__loadSession` answers `{ session: null, error }` when the stored access token has expired and the refresh fails (GoTrueClient.js:2549-2573), keeping the stored session for a retryable (network) failure. The sign-in page is outside the shell, so nothing re-checks.
impact: On a shared or borrowed computer, staff who come back to an idle admin tab (token expired) and press «تسجيل الخروج» while the connection is down see the sign-in page and leave; the refresh token stays in the browser, and the next person to open /admin once the network is back is signed in as them (an owner's session reaches orders, refunds' screens and the team). The drafts are gone, which makes the sign-out look complete.
proposed_fix: Read `{ error }` from signOut; on an error, remove the stored session anyway (`localStorage` key `sb-<project-ref>-auth-token`, or `signOut({ scope: 'local' })` after a successful `refreshSession` attempt) and, if that is not possible, stay on the page with «تعذّر تسجيل الخروج؛ تحقق من الاتصال ثم أعد المحاولة.».
proof_recipe: Playwright: sign in as staff; in the page, rewrite the stored session's expires_at to a past epoch (`const k=Object.keys(localStorage).find(k=>k.endsWith('-auth-token')); const s=JSON.parse(localStorage[k]); s.expires_at=1; localStorage[k]=JSON.stringify(s)`); context.setOffline(true); click «تسجيل الخروج» (accept the confirm if drafts exist). Wrong result: the URL becomes /admin/sign-in while localStorage[k] still holds the refresh token; context.setOffline(false) and goto('/admin') shows the signed-in home.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-2 ADMIN-auth-2 fixed the opposite case (a transient failure read as a sign-out); ARCH-14 (this run) covers tokens in localStorage generally.

title: A schedule whose time has passed is still shown as waiting («مجدول في …», «مستندات تنتظر موعد النشر: 1»), so a stopped publish_due job is never visible in the admin
evidence: The home counts every document with a pending schedule, `.not('scheduled_at', 'is', null)` (AdminHome.tsx:217-225), and prints «مستندات تنتظر موعد النشر: {count}» (396) with no comparison to now; PublishBar prints «مجدول: نسخة N في {formatRiyadh(scheduledAt)}.» (PublishBar.tsx:146-151) and CollectionList «مجدول في …» (CollectionList.tsx:43-48), past or not. A schedule stays pending until `publish_due()` runs: the pg_cron job 'content-publish-due' every minute (20260925120000_content_versions_and_publishing.sql:299), which records no job_runs row (KNOWN_JOBS at AdminHome.tsx:33 has no content entry).
impact: If the minute job stops (a restore that lost the cron jobs, pg_cron disabled, the job's command failing), an article scheduled for 9:00 is still «مجدول في 9:00» at noon and on the following days, the home calls it waiting, and Anas assumes it is live. The overdue time is the one cheap signal the admin already has and does not use.
proposed_fix: Treat `scheduled_at < now() - 5 minutes` as overdue: the home shows «نشر مجدول متأخر: N — تحقق من مهام التشغيل» in red, and the bar and the list say «تأخر النشر المجدول (كان في …)».
prior_overlap: ARCH-13 (this run) covers unmonitored pure-SQL cron jobs in general; this is the admin display that would reveal content-publish-due's failure.

title: The documents list has no loading, failure or empty state: until the query answers, and for good if it fails, every room, policy and the settings read «مسودة لم تُنشر» and «لم يُحفظ بعد», and the articles list is a bare table
evidence: `rows` starts as null (56) and stays null when the query fails (68-71). The fixed collections are listed regardless (81-89) and each row renders `statusFor(row)` and `row ? formatRiyadh(row.latest_at) : 'لم يُحفظ بعد'` (168-169), where `statusFor(undefined)` is 'مسودة لم تُنشر' (41-42). For posts and taxonomies `docIds` is `[]` while rows is null (90-92), so the table shows only its header; there is no «يحمّل...» and no «لا توجد مقالات بعد». The project's own rule is D21 'unavailable is unavailable, not zero' (AdminHome.tsx:5-6).
impact: On a slow connection, or when the read fails, Anas sees all five rooms, the four policies and the site settings described as never-saved, unpublished drafts (next to the small «تعذّر تحميل القائمة.» line when it failed), and an empty articles table that looks like his articles are gone; he may press «جديد» and rewrite one.
proposed_fix: Render «يحمّل...» while `rows === null && !error`, hide the status and date cells (or the table) when the load failed, and show «لا توجد مقالات بعد.» / «لا توجد تصنيفات بعد.» for an empty open collection.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-2 ADMIN-publish-8 made the load error announced; the rows it leaves under it were not addressed. P10 plans «Admin screens complete empty/loading/validation/error/success flows» (WORK-PACKAGES.md P10), which would cover it; today the list misstates the state.

title: Pasting a checklist (Google Docs, GitHub, Joplin) creates a 'check' list the allowlist refuses: publishing is blocked, while the toolbar calls it «قائمة نقطية»
evidence: The paste transforms cover headings, links and tabs only (RichTextEditor.tsx:209-227), under a comment that ends 'so publishing is never blocked by a paste' (203-208). Lexical 0.51's list import makes `$createListNode('check')` for a `ul` with `__lexicallisttype=check`, class `contains-task-list` (GitHub), `data-is-checklist=1` (Joplin) or children carrying `aria-checked` (Google Docs checklists) (@lexical/list LexicalList.dev.js:1648-1673). The schema allows `listType: z.enum(['bullet', 'number'])` only (src/admin/richtext.ts:35-39); reproduced with the repo's zod (SCRATCH/ADMIN-CMS/rt-check2.cjs): a root holding a check list fails with path ['root','children',1] and «يحتوي النص عنصرًا غير صالح؛ احذف ما لصقته أو أعد كتابة الفقرة.». The toolbar maps any non-number list to 'bullet' (RichTextEditor.tsx:82), so the list looks like an ordinary bullet list.
impact: Anas drafts in Google Docs, pastes an article that contains a checklist: Save works but «نشر» and «جدولة» stay disabled, the error names «النص › root › children › N» and tells him to delete what he pasted, and nothing on screen shows which list is the culprit.
proposed_fix: Add a ListNode transform beside the others: `editor.registerNodeTransform(ListNode, (node) => { if (node.getListType() === 'check') node.setListType('bullet') })`, plus a unit test like the tab one.
proof_recipe:
Playwright on a post: focus «محرر النص المنسق» and dispatch a paste with text/html '
  • بند
' (page.evaluate with a ClipboardEvent and DataTransfer), then «حفظ». Wrong result: the error list shows «النص › root › children › 1: يحتوي النص عنصرًا غير صالح…» and «نشر» stays disabled.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 S08.7 (h1/h4-h6, non-https links) and AUDIT-2 4.5 / ADMIN-publish-1 (tabs) fixed the other paste cases; check lists were not covered.

title: The book photo's «نقطة التركيز» is free text written into an inline style: a value with ';' adds any CSS declaration to the public /book page
evidence: `{ name: 'focus', label: 'نقطة التركيز', type: 'text', required: false }` (rooms.ts:243-244, comment 'A CSS object-position such as `50% 36%`') has no pattern, in the form, the publish gate or the build schema (bookRoomSchema, 289). BookView passes it on, `focus={photo.focus || undefined}` (BookView.tsx:194), and the server component Figure writes `style={{ ... '--focus-point': focus }}` (weave/Figure.tsx:42). React 19.3's server renderer copies a custom property's value verbatim; checked with the repo's react-dom (SCRATCH/ADMIN-CMS/ssr-style.cjs): `--focus-point` = '50% 36%; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: red' renders `<figure style="--focus-point:50% 36%; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: red">`. The only stored values are '50% 36%' and '50% 25%' (content/initial-content.json).
impact: Anyone holding an editor session (a lent laptop, a phished editor, a careless paste) can publish a page-covering overlay or a third-party background image on /book: defacement of the book page and, while there is no CSP (P10), a tracking request to an outside host from every visitor. No script runs; the reach is the CSS of one public page.
proposed_fix: Give the field `pattern: { regex: /^\d{1,3}% \d{1,3}%$/, message: 'اكتب موضعًا مثل 50% 36%.' }` (schemaFromFields applies it to the form, the gate and the build; both stored values match), and in Figure drop a focus value that does not match the same pattern.
prior_overlap: none

title: The security page tells the owner the authenticator is needed only for team actions; since P08 it also guards refunds, disputes, the seller details, the policy approval and the checkout switch
evidence:
`{role === 'owner' &&

مطلوب لتفعيل إجراءات الفريق: الدعوة وتغيير الدور والإيقاف.

title: Note for the in-flight staff-admin change: its two revoke failure replies tell the owner something TeamView cannot match («حُدّثت الحالة» after the row was put back to active; «حاول مرة أخرى» after SESSIONS_FAILED, when the row already reads «موقوف» and the only button is «استعادة»)
evidence: Uncommitted working-tree diff (git diff supabase/functions/staff-admin/index.ts): `if (banError) await admin.from('staff').update({ active: true }).eq('user_id', userId)` is added before the unchanged `fail(500, 'BAN_FAILED', 'حُدّثت الحالة لكن تعذّر إيقاف الدخول. حاول مرة أخرى.')` (line 146), and a new `fail(500, 'SESSIONS_FAILED', 'أُوقف الدخول لكن تعذّر إنهاء الجلسات المفتوحة. حاول مرة أخرى.')` returns after the ban succeeded. TeamView prints the message (runAction, TeamView.tsx:93), reloads the row, and offers one toggle per row: «إيقاف» for an active member, «استعادة» for a revoked one (214-226); its comment still says 'BAN_FAILED commits `active` first' (94).
impact: Once the change lands: after a ban failure the owner reads that the status was updated while the reloaded row says «نشط»; after SESSIONS_FAILED he is told to try again, but the row says «موقوف» and the only control restores the member, so the open sessions can be ended only by restoring and revoking again.
proposed_fix: Word BAN_FAILED «تعذّر إيقاف الدخول، وبقي العضو نشطًا. حاول مرة أخرى.». For SESSIONS_FAILED, the server already accepts a second set_active false on an inactive member (it re-runs the ban and staff_sessions_end, staff-admin/index.ts:120-146), so TeamView only needs to offer «أعد الإيقاف» on that row after this code instead of the lone «استعادة»; update the TeamView comment.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 S10.9 (BAN_FAILED display); the orchestrator's uncommitted FABLE-AUDIT edit.
